title: Dashboard UI upgrade session: fast live overview, work-queue snapshot, prop uPnL, nav order, merged Roadmap+Work tab, Google+passkey site login, signals catalog placeholder, keys admin
note: [2026-10-11T09:40Z operator request; popup answers: login 'Google + passkey', keys 'View + edit, passkey each time', schedule 'Roadmap two now, UI after'] Items: (1) TOP: faster data loading; data on the page live all the time even if charts are not per-tick; cut lag (overview first) - tens of seconds for little data makes no sense. (2) Work-queue snapshot on the overview: last 5 closed, open now, next 5, plus a box for items waiting on the operator. (3) Prop accounts show no uPnL: keep a regularly updated snapshot and display it. (4) Nav order: real money, then paper, then Prop. (5) Work page 'today's brief' included in the 'last report' roster (usually the latest). (6) Fold Roadmap and Work tabs into one. (7) DB sign-in creds unclear: explain the mechanism, replace with Google OAuth to the operator's account + passkey 2FA, covering the WHOLE site, long-lived per-device session (revocable). (8) Signals catalog placeholder on the strategies/models page. (9) Admin keys tab: list keys, value hidden behind an eye icon, editable field prefilled with current value + Save; per operator: reveal/save re-prompts the passkey, values never cached client-side, every reveal/change audited + pinged to SYSTEM. Repos: benbaichmankass/ict-trader-dashboard (SPA) + this repo (API). Security items 7+9 are Tier-2/3 auth changes: ship behind tests, keep CORS intact.
